states.name: Maharashtra
states.culture: Muhurat-driven buying (Gudi Padwa, Dasara, Padwa) for gold/vehicles; Ganeshotsav is the biggest spend; Mumbai/Pune heavy quick-commerce users
states.ecommerce: Largest e-commerce state: ~15% of buyers and 15% of sellers (Shiprocket 2023); Mumbai/Pune among Meesho's top Chaturthi markets; Ganpati idol q-com sales +300% in 2025

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.significance: Sun's northward transit; til-gul exchange, women's haldi-kumkum gatherings
festivals.buys: til-gul, halwa jewellery, black sankranti sarees, kites, haldi-kumkum return gifts (vaan)
festivals.impact_reason: Black sarees/kids' halwa jewellery and vaan gift items sold online; small-ticket basket

festivals.name: Shivaji Jayanti
festivals.significance: Birth anniversary of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj; state holiday, processions
festivals.impact_reason: Mostly local rally merchandise; limited online lift

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri
festivals.significance: Night-long Shiva worship; temple fairs and fasting
festivals.buys: fasting foods, bel leaves, puja items, rudraksha
festivals.impact_reason: Fasting groceries via quick commerce; small baskets

festivals.name: Holi and Rang Panchami

festivals.buys: gulal, pichkaris, white kurtas, sweets (puran poli), skin/hair care

festivals.name: Gudi Padwa

festivals.name: Ram Navami
